import pyautogui, time

# click at the start of line 2
pyautogui.click(200, 185)
time.sleep(0.5)

# drag down to the start of line 10 to select lines 2–10
pyautogui.dragTo(200, 337, duration=0.5, button='left')
time.sleep(0.2)

# indent the selected lines by one tab
pyautogui.press('tab')

import pyautogui, time

time.sleep(0.5)
# go to start of file
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'home')
time.sleep(0.2)
# move down to line 2
pyautogui.press('down')
time.sleep(0.1)
# extend selection from line 2 down to line 10 (8 more lines)
for _ in range(8):
    pyautogui.keyDown('shift')
    pyautogui.press('down')
    pyautogui.keyUp('shift')
    time.sleep(0.1)
# indent all selected lines
pyautogui.press('tab')
